findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables. This exposes long-lived AWS credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, code repository, or Lambda console/API, enabling full impersonation of the associated IAM identity.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key for encrypting environment variables, so sensitive values (including the hardcoded credentials) are only protected by the default Lambda service key rather than a customer-managed key with tighter access controls.
